title: fix(filters): GradientGlowFilter compositeSource always 0 when property is false/absent
description:
In writeGradientGlowFilter (packages/swf/src/filters.ts line ~208): the compositeSource bit (bit 5) is only set if f.compositeSource is truthy. For most GradientGlow filters imported from binary FLA, compositeSource=true (the object remains visible). But if the model has compositeSource=false or undefined, the bit is 0, which means 'hide_object' in Ruffle (COMPOSITE_SOURCE=0 → object is hidden behind its glow).

The GlowFilter encoder always sets bit 5 unconditionally (line 85: 'flags |= 1 << 5; // CompositeSource — always 1'), treating compositeSource as always-on. The GradientGlowFilter encoder conditionally sets it based on f.compositeSource, which is correct — but a newly constructed defaultGradientGlow() (packages/core/src/engine/filters.ts line ~300) must default compositeSource to true. Check defaultGradientGlow() returns compositeSource: true, and verify the model's default.

Also: writeGradientBevelFilter has the same conditional compositeSource pattern (line 245). Both gradient filters' default value functions must have compositeSource: true.
